business_problem: MozzartBet.com needed to modernize a VMware-centric infrastructure because growing microservices, container workloads, and data initiatives demanded more flexibility and near real-time performance without sacrificing reliability.
solution_summary: MozzartBet.com modernized its data and application platform by moving from a more rigid virtualization stack to a unified Red Hat OpenShift and IBM Fusion HCI foundation. The company had previously used IBM Netezza as its data warehouse, but adopted OpenShift and Fusion HCI to support near real-time analytics, cloud-native development, and broader application modernization. The new platform now spans production, staging, and development clusters, supports containerized business services, and gives the organization a practical path for migrating workloads from VMs to containers. IBM Cloud remains part of the architecture for non-critical workloads and development environments, creating a hybrid operating model that balances cost, regulatory requirements, and flexibility. By standardizing on OpenShift plus Fusion HCI, MozzartBet.com created one resilient platform for analytics and production services while preserving the reliability required by an always-on betting business that spans online and retail channels.
